title: Electronic Music
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Certificate of Achievement in Electronic Music
outcomes: Demonstrate proficiency with audio-video equipment, including live content acquisition, microphones, video cameras, sound reinforcement, post-production editing, mixing, mastering, metering, and system troubleshooting.
Evaluate merits of professional media productions with an understanding of technical and aesthetic considerations appropriate for various genres.

Distinguish between related career paths associated with the discipline of Music Technology, including digital media content creation, technical support, marketing, entrepreneurship, and business administrative positions.

notes: Catalog codes are printed without the leading zero (MTEC 62A vs closed-list MTEC 062A); treated as the same courses.
MTEC 62C is not in the closed list; recorded as a catalog addition.
Units for the alternatives MTEC 72B and MTEC 72C are not printed on their rows; the 4 units on the MTEC 70A row cover the choice.

The program learning outcomes are printed once for the Music Technology program as a whole and the excerpt begins mid-list (first outcome cut off at 'orkflows.'); only the three complete outcomes were recorded, assumed shared by this certificate. Reviewer should check the full list.
Careers taken from the program-wide Career Opportunities section.
Units are quarter units (Foothill is on the quarter system); 16 quarter units fits the 12Q to fewer than 24Q award band.
